title: Define a full testing taxonomy and conformance lifecycle
requirements:
- Distinguish conformance, interoperability, performance/resilience, security, clinical-safety, usability/accessibility and operational acceptance testing
- Supplement actor-role and simulator testing with peer, multi-role and end-to-end scenario testing
- Extend 4.3.5 beyond test beds to reuse of international test plans, validators and tooling
- Require regression/revalidation after material changes and periodic surveillance testing
- Add a conformance category requiring decision-support engines to load and execute published L3 artefacts faithfully
- Cover privacy, security, resilience, accessibility, performance and clinical safety
- Add example test scenarios for specimen traceability, consent withdrawal, provenance and correction workflows
- For each give purpose, object under test, evidence and responsible body
